stemMd: What is the maximum value of 4 − 3cos x for real x?
explanationMd: Cosine ranges from −1 to 1. Multiplying by −3 gives values from −3 to 3, then adding four gives the range [1,7]. The maximum seven occurs when cos x=−1.

distractorRationale.d: This is the minimum, reached when cosine is one.
distractorRationale.a: This is the midpoint of the range.
distractorRationale.c: This is the oscillation amplitude, not the maximum output.
distractorRationale.e: This has the wrong sign and lies outside the range.
